Learn more Comments 321 In this video Chapters Description How to File a (FREE) Tax Extension Form 4868 | Complete Instructions 2.3KLikes98,153Views2023Apr 12 In this video I show you how to prepare and file Form 4868, Application for Automatic Extension of Time to File U.S. Individual Income Tax Return with the IRS to avoid late filing penalties. I'll walk you through the form step by step and give you some insights on things to keep in mind so you don't make mistakes and have the form rejected. As a preview of what you can expect to see and learn, I’m going to show you: How to file the form if you are mailing in a payment How to file the form if you are NOT mailing a payment How to file electronically and avoid having to send anything in the mail. How to estimate your taxes owed. My recommendations on how to send the form to the IRS if filing through the mail. IRS Form 4868: https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/f4868... Nerdwallet Income Tax Calculator: https://www.nerdwallet.com/taxes/tax-...
